intro: Small spaces deserve big ideas. The Buddy table brings together durable materials, and smooth mobility—helping you stay productive without sacrificing style or space.

features.title: Ample worktop space for efficiency
features.text: A generous tabletop provides ample room for your laptop, notebooks, and other essentials, keeping your workspace organised and efficient.

features.title: Colours that blend and calm
features.text: The beech and grey finish feels fresh and modern—great for homes that value subtle, easygoing design.

features.title: Room to move, space to think
features.text: Our open leg space design gives you full freedom of movement, helping you stay focused without feeling boxed in.

features.title: Built for compact living
features.text: Whether you’re furnishing a nook or setting up in your bedroom, our table is purposefully corner-friendly and clutter-free.

name: Buddy Engineered Wood Computer Table
